info.title: alineod — swarm control API
info.description: Initiate and orchestrate agent swarms. alineod drives OpenSandbox through the alineo SDK; this is the language-neutral wire contract.

post.summary: Create a run (load the root agent)

prompt.description: If set, drive one turn on the root agent after load.

budget.description: Overrides the spec's own spawnDepth / maxAgents (flag-beats-config).

state.description: Always "provisioning" at return time (the route is async) — poll for the real state.

pausedBy.description: While paused: "operator" (it was the target) or "cascade" (a subtree pause reached it).

asOf.description: Highest ledger seq reflected in this projection.

delete.summary: Tear down the run (keeps the ledger)

get.summary: SSE stream of the whole swarm
get.description: text/event-stream. alineod agent_* events plus forwarded harness events, each tagged with agentId. Honours Last-Event-ID (the ledger seq).

waitFor.description: Hold the spawn until the named agents resolve (hold-then-spawn, D-c). A plain array means mode "settled": every agent terminal, any outcome.

mode.description: settled: every agent terminal, any outcome · all: every agent succeeded · any: the first to settle · quorum: k successes.

k.description: quorum: how many successes are needed (default: all).

onDepFailure.description: all / quorum: what a failed dependency (or an unreachable quorum) does. Default fail.

onDeadline.description: At the deadline: proceed with whatever settled (partial), or fail. Default proceed.

notifyOn.description: Tell this child when each named agent finishes, without blocking it (per-agent inbox): steered in if it's running, held while paused, prepended to its next prompt if idle.

budget.description: Overrides the spec's own spawnDepth / maxAgents (flag-beats-config).

idempotencyKey.description: D-f: a retried POST with the same key returns the original spawn instead of creating a second child.

state.description: "spawning" if waitFor is set, else "provisioning" — poll for the real state.

pausedBy.description: While paused: "operator" (it was the target) or "cascade" (a subtree pause reached it).

post.description: Steer never broadcasts (research/swarm-control.md §8a). With scope: "subtree", the agent gets one message — the steer plus a roster of its direct children — and redirects them itself.

scope.description: "subtree": deliver ONE message to this agent — your text plus a roster of its direct children — so it re-plans and redirects each child itself. Never a broadcast.

schema.description: Injected into the agent's current turn (research/swarm-control.md §8).

200.description: scope: subtree — how the parent got the message, and its roster

deliveredAs.description: steer: into its running turn · turn: a new turn (it was idle) · queued: it's paused; delivered on resume

post.summary: Freeze the agent's sandbox container (or, with scope: subtree, it and every descendant)

scope.description: "agent" (default): the named agent only. "subtree": the agent and every descendant — pause parents-first, resume children-first.

200.description: scope: subtree — one result per member, parents paused first

asOf.description: Highest ledger seq when the subtree's membership was resolved.

schema.description: Best-effort, per member: one member failing doesn't undo or block the rest.

post.summary: Unfreeze the agent's sandbox container (or, with scope: subtree, it and every paused descendant)

scope.description: "agent" (default): the named agent only. "subtree": the agent and every descendant — pause parents-first, resume children-first.

200.description: scope: subtree — one result per member, children resumed first

asOf.description: Highest ledger seq when the subtree's membership was resolved.

schema.description: Best-effort, per member: one member failing doesn't undo or block the rest.

409.description: Agent not paused, or not live

post.summary: Abort + close an agent (or, with scope: subtree, it and every descendant)
post.description: Stopping an agent that already finished closes its sandbox and emits agent_released, keeping its outcome.

scope.description: "subtree": the agent and every descendant, leaves first, with one result per member.

200.description: scope: subtree — one result per member, leaves stopped first

asOf.description: Highest ledger seq when the subtree's membership was resolved.

schema.description: Best-effort, per member: one member failing doesn't undo or block the rest.

get.summary: Wait until the agent's subtree is quiescent

200.description: The subtree's quiescence — returned early once it's quiescent

quiescent.description: Every member terminal and none still being spawned. Paused members count as not quiescent.

post.summary: Wait on a set of agents (waitFor modes) or a subtree, without spawning

subtree.description: Wait for this agent's subtree to become quiescent instead.

mode.description: settled: every agent terminal, any outcome · all: every agent succeeded · any: the first to settle · quorum: k successes.

wait.description: Seconds to hold the request (capped server-side).

200.description: Resolved, or pending once `wait` ran out

400.description: Invalid body, k, or an agent not in this run

post.summary: Tell this agent when each listed agent finishes (per-agent inbox)

wake.description: If the subscriber is idle when a notification arrives, start a turn with it instead of queueing it.

get.summary: This agent's pending and delivered notifications

post.summary: Deliver pending notifications now (a new turn if the agent is idle)

200.description: { delivery: steer | turn | held | dropped | none }

get.summary: What the agent said and did, turn by turn (messages, tool calls, errors)

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Don't shorten long text; include the model's thinking.
